name: Tame-san
message: 「Ho. The young couple's both here today!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll bring you some water right away. The usual?」
I make eye contact with Nanaka's old man.
'One tsukimi. And two orders of mori coming up'

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I just kind of get it」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Looks like there's only one way. Synn's gotta marry into the family」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--how do you jump to that conclusion!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Tame-san! Don't just decide things on your own!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right. Nanaka's troubled by it too...」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Oh-ho, troubled by it, are you? My apologies then」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's not like I'm troubled or anything...」

name: Tame-san
message: 「O-Oh, looks like you've got a customer」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, long time no see! How've you been?」
After greeting me, Tinun carried a tray with two servings of country-style soba over to the customers.
Jangara, working over there, looks energetic too.
They've completely blended into the shop's atmosphere. Thank goodness.
Mochimochi was sleeping on top of the household Shinto altar.
It's blending right into the atmosphere without a care in the world, sure, but this probably isn't good.
On my way to grab a tray of mori soba, I picked Mochimochi up off the altar.
Sensing some kind of eye contact, I turn around.
'Synn-kun. Take that one to the kitchen'
'We'll just let it sleep somewhere back there'
Nanaka's old man gave a solemn nod.

name: Synn
message: 「Helping out? I don't mind at all」

name: Synn
message: 「In exchange, I'd love it if you treated me to some more of your delicious soba」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I picked the wrong spot... There's no way we can be alone together like this...」
'You can clock out now. You were a big help today'
'No, something like this is no trouble at all. Please call on me anytime'
'Why don't you just marry into our family, Synn-kun?'
'Th-That depends on how Nanaka feels about it too!'
Sometimes I wonder if it doesn't even get through at all.
Still, I wonder if he was serious just now, her old man... Good thing Nanaka can't hear him, though.
If she had heard that, what would Nanaka have thought?

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no way we can be alone together at the shop! My old man's there too...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Sigh... Must be nice for you, having zero worries」
Even though your old man was just giving me a huge headache a moment ago.

name: Synn
message: 「I've definitely got a worry or two of my own, you know!」
There's no way I could tell Nanaka to her face that I was rattled over marrying into her family.

name: Paqy
message: 「Aren't you worried about something else, Soba?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up, panda! I said nothing, I mean nothing!」
It must be about the Holy Night Festival, after all... It probably isn't the same kind of problem I'm having... I'm sure of it.

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, this much is nothing. You're always helping me out.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What do you think Soba's worried about?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's about the Holy Night Festival. Probably. Like getting hold of sweets and stuff」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I don't have any money, contacts, or connections... Hrmmm」
